Craving your favourite street food but want to enjoy those irresistible flavours at home? This one’s for you!
In this video, we’re bringing the delicious taste of street-side favourites straight to your kitchen with 3 mouth-watering recipes — Mumbai-style Chicken Frankie, Street-Style Veg Paratha and a loaded Schezwan Masala Toast.
Enjoy soft roti with juicy, flavourful chicken filling in the Frankie, a crispy and delicious vegetable-stuffed paratha, and a cheesy, chutney-loaded Masala Toast packed with layers of street-style flavour.
